div.div: A booking occurrence is one booking of one resource for one time slot. It can come from self-service (the web app, an assistant or the API), from an allocation run, or from a booking made in Exchange or on a room panel. Once it is allocated, the resource is yours, and once you check in, it is taken. States with a bold border are end states.

Once it is allocated, the resource is yours, and once you check in, it is taken. States
with a bold border are end states.

div.div: A booking intent asks for a kind of space, such as a height-adjustable desk, never a specific one. Requests the run cannot place join the single waitlist in the order they were made. If the person needs parking, a locker or a bike rack to come in at all, the request is placed only once that is secured too.
